headline: West Alabama win away at every side above them
dek: West Alabama's win at Trevecca, who had beaten them on the same ground in October, followed wins at UAH and at AUM. Trevecca have lost twice in eighteen matches, both at home.
displaced_by: West Alabama won at Trevecca: the meeting the standing headline anticipated has been played, and 'lost once in seventeen' no longer holds.
